caption_L1: Here a bar graph is labeled Number of the coronavirus (COVID-19) cases across Indian states and union territories as of December 17 , 2020 , by type. There is a linear scale of range 0 to 60,000 along the x-axis, marked Active. The y-axis measures state of India using a categorical scale starting with Andaman and Nicobar Islands and ending with West Bengal.
caption_L2L3: Most states had low numbers and some even had zero or close to zero. Two states had by far the highest number of cases - Maharashtra and Kerala. Most states had below 20,000 cases.
